341-4399-4770--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Umori.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
341-4399-4770--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1238-3147-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
1238-3147-8323-8324.description:
Play Azorius Chancery
When Azorius Chancery enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

323-1981-2415-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
323-1981-2415-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4770-4927-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2527-3143-3464-8095.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Hyrax Tower Scout has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-3143-3464-8095.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from Hyrax Tower Scout if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3591-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
3591-6034-8089.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

5641-6822-7687.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
5641-6822-7687.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-5419-7824.description:
Activate Kalain by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kalain enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kalain.
Resolve the Kalain trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-745-1619-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-745-1619-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Mirrorhall Mimic and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-745-1619-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2946-4871-6248-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-6248-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2946-3967-4871-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4871-6248.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-5614-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-6633.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5231-6258--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat.

891-2961-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

791-2290-7267.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-7267.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

5147-7084-7201.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4661-5282-7149.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Vesuvan Doppelganger from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

4046-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
4046-7070--141.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
4046-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

277-573-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-573-5702-6850.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

147-2034-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1567-3227.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Momentary Blink exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1567-3227.description:
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scrivener and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scrivener trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Momentary Blink.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scrivener and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2341-3649-5940.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
2341-3649-5940.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {1}{R}{R}, choosing its first mode, copying Etrata's trigger.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

560-647-2457-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3705-5231-5997-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
3705-5231-5997-6747.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2445-3693-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Branching Evolution.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
2445-3693-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista if desired.

2382-5231-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
2382-5231-5659--33.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf, adding {R}.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3719-4661-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Vesuvan Doppelganger has a power of at least 2.
3719-4661-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Vesuvan Doppelganger and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Vesuvan Doppelganger from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Vesuvan Doppelganger to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-2781-5917.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
2557-2781-5917.description:
Activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Felidar Guardian that are 1/1 Balloons with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

2079-3259-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-3259-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1992-2034-2646.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-2034-2646.description:

When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

121-762-3765.description:
Cast End the Festivities by paying {R}.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve End the Festivities, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

3525-3590-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura and Paradise Mantle attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3590-4474.description:

Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

1339-1636-4041.notablePrerequisites: Merfolk Looter does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-4041.description:
Activate Merfolk Looter by tapping it, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

539-3459-4934-5078.notablePrerequisites: Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness.
539-3459-4934-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem using its Forest ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Battered Golem triggers, untapping it.
Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, triggering Amareth.
In response, activate Sensei's Divining Top's last ability by tapping it, drawing a card, then putting Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve Amareth's trigger, putting Sensei's Divining Top from your library into your hand.
Repeat.

411-2146-4720-4893.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

67-413-4681.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide and up to one other creature enter the battlefield, Karmic Guide triggers, and Blasting Station triggeers once for each creature that entered the battlefield.
Resolve all Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger from step 4, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
